stem.text: A firework travels vertically upwards in air. Gases are pushed vertically downwards from the firework.
Several forces that act on the firework and gases are shown.

stem.alt: Force diagram of a firework-shaped object. Vertical arrows: thrust pointing up from the top; air resistance and force on gases pointing down; weight pointing down. Labelled NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: Which forces are a Newton’s third law pair?

A.text: air resistance and force on gases
